name: Log, edit and retain a period
description: A saved and edited log persists and drives the overview estimate.
steps: Click Log period. Set start date to 2026-09-01 and end date to 2026-09-05, select Cramps and enter note First cycle. Save period.
Open History and edit that entry. Change flow to Light and note to Updated cycle. Save.
Refresh the page, open History and verify the updated entry. Open Overview.
expected: The September 1–5 log retains Light flow, Cramps and Updated cycle. Overview shows estimated next period September 29, 2026 and cycle length 28 days.

name: Calendar and preferences on mobile
description: Cycle settings persist and a period produces the correct predicted calendar range.
steps: Open Settings. Set cycle length to 30 and period length to 4. Save preferences.
Log a period with start 2026-09-01 and end 2026-09-04. Save.
Refresh and verify Settings retains 30 and 4. Open Calendar and use month arrows to reach October 2026, then September 2026.
expected: Controls fit the mobile screen. September 1–4 are logged and October 1–4 are estimated. Preferences remain saved.

name: Reject invalid and overlapping dates
description: Invalid period data cannot create a log.
steps: Open Log period and enter a start date of 2099-01-01. Try to save.
Enter start 2026-09-15 and end 2026-09-12. Try to save.
Verify overlap error then Cancel. Open History.
expected: Future dates and reversed dates are rejected. Overlapping dates show an error. Only the original September 10–14 entry exists.

name: Delete logs and export or erase data
description: Deletion requires confirmation and erased records remain absent after reload.
setup: Create a period with start 2026-08-01 and end 2026-08-04.
steps: Open History and click delete on the August entry. Cancel and verify it remains.
Delete it again and Confirm delete. Refresh and verify it is absent.
Open Settings and click Export data. Verify a JSON file downloads.
Click Delete all data, Confirm delete and refresh. Open History and Overview.
expected: Cancellation preserves the entry, confirmed deletion removes it, export downloads JSON, and clearing all data leaves an empty history with no estimated next period. Browser-only storage information is visible.
